questions.question: Answers keep coming back as paragraphs instead of bullet lists. Fix?
questions.explanation: Show two short examples in the target format; examples steer format more reliably than emphasis.

questions.question: A support bot invents refund rules. Fix?
questions.answer: Put the policy text in context and tell it to answer only from it.
questions.explanation: Grounding the answer in provided text is the first line of defense against invented facts.

questions.question: Where do you put a long reference document: system prompt or user message?
questions.explanation: Keep stable instructions in the system prompt and the document in a clearly delimited block; order and delimiters change what the model attends to.

questions.question: What's a sign your system prompt is too long?
questions.answer: Rules contradict each other and nobody tests them.
questions.explanation: Untested rules pile up; evals keep a prompt honest.

questions.question: Which one caps the answer length?
questions.explanation: max_tokens limits output; the window limits input plus output.

questions.question: Three examples all end with "Hope this helps!". What happens?
questions.answer: Most answers will end that way too.
questions.explanation: The model copies patterns in examples, including the ones you didn't mean.

questions.question: Instruction says "no summary", examples have summaries. Which wins?
questions.explanation: When instructions and examples disagree, examples tend to win.
